wire.radient_saver.section.title.role: settings section title in the TUI /settings page and connected settings UIs
wire.radient_saver.section.title.note: 'Radient Saver' is a product name: never translate it. '(beta)' marks the feature's release stage and must stay visible.

wire.radient_saver.section.description.note: 'Radient Saver', 'Saver' and 'Radient' are product names: never translate them. The sentence 'Saver never sends your AI provider's credentials to Radient' is a mandatory security statement: keep its meaning exact (credentials = API keys and sign-in tokens for the user's AI provider such as Anthropic or OpenAI). 'Turn' = one request/answer exchange with the model.

wire.radient_saver.mode.label.note: Product name plus the release stage. 'Radient Saver' is never translated; '(beta)' must stay visible.

wire.radient_saver.mode.help.note: Product names 'Radient Saver', 'Saver', 'Radient' are never translated. 'LOP_RADIENT_SAVER' is an environment variable name: copy it exactly. The credential sentence is a mandatory security statement; keep its meaning exact. 'Radient credits' is the prepaid balance on the user's Radient account. 'Keeps none of its content' means Radient stores nothing of the conversation.

wire.radient_saver.mode.choice.off.label.note: Choice value shown beside the description. Short, lowercase where the language allows.

wire.radient_saver.mode.choice.off.descr.note: Off is the shipped default. 'History' = the conversation's earlier messages.

wire.radient_saver.mode.choice.opt_in.la.note: The feature is allowed, but each session must turn it on itself.

wire.radient_saver.mode.choice.opt_in.de.note: Allowed but off by default for each session; a later release adds the per-session switch.

wire.radient_saver.notice.unavailable.role: transient session notice (warning) shown once per session in the conversation
wire.radient_saver.notice.unavailable.note: The service could not be reached or timed out. The user's turn still succeeds; only the saving is skipped. 'Full history' = the whole conversation sent unshortened.

wire.radient_saver.notice.rejected.role: transient session notice (warning) shown once per session
wire.radient_saver.notice.rejected.note: The client validated the server's answer and refused it. Nothing went wrong for the user; the turn succeeds with the full history.

wire.radient_saver.notice.signed_out.role: transient session notice (warning) shown once per session
wire.radient_saver.notice.signed_out.note: '/login radient' is a command the user types: copy it exactly, never translate it.

wire.radient_saver.notice.no_credit.role: transient session notice (warning) shown once per session
wire.radient_saver.notice.no_credit.note: 'console.radienthq.com' is a web address: copy it exactly. 'Credit' = prepaid money on the Radient account.

wire.radient_saver.notice.rate_limited.role: transient session notice (info/warning) shown once per session
wire.radient_saver.notice.rate_limited.note: The service asked the client to slow down; it resumes by itself.

wire.radient_saver.notice.disabled.role: transient session notice (warning) shown once per session
wire.radient_saver.notice.disabled.note: Covers a server without the feature, a non-standard Radient address, or a sign-in that cannot be used for Saver. No action is implied.

wire.radient_saver.notice.oversize.role: transient session notice (info/warning) shown once per session
wire.radient_saver.notice.oversize.note: A single message (typically a very large tool output) is bigger than Saver can accept. It is sent in full; the rest of the conversation keeps being shortened. No action is needed.

wire.radient_saver.command.description.note: Product name 'Radient Saver' stays unchanged; this changes only the current session, never the global config file.

wire.radient_saver.command.radient_descr.note: Radient is a product name; these are controls for the current session.

wire.radient_saver.command.usage.note: Copy every command token exactly: /saver, on, off, status and inherit. Bare /saver toggles; inherit clears the session override so the global setting applies.

wire.radient_saver.command.enabled.note: The explicit session override is on; the global config file is deliberately unchanged. No savings or percentage claim.

wire.radient_saver.command.disabled.note: The explicit session override is off; the global config file is deliberately unchanged.

wire.radient_saver.command.inherited.note: The explicit session override was cleared. Global setting and agent designation are product concepts; translate naturally.

wire.radient_saver.command.status.on.note: Copy commands exactly; no savings or percentage claim.

wire.radient_saver.command.badge.role: small TUI status badge beside the model
wire.radient_saver.command.badge.note: Technical short form of the product name; keep 'saver' in Latin lowercase so the reserved-width badge is stable.
